cards.name: Thud
cards.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Thud deals damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target.

cards.name: Thud-for-Duds
cards.oracleText: Whenever you crank this Contraption, roll two six-sided dice. This Contraption deals damage to target creature equal to the difference between those results.
